abstract: In a series of 82 patients with tumors of the thymus and thymic region there were 11 with teratomas and germinal tumors. Four of these patients had benign cystic teratomas, 4 had malignant teratomas, 1 had an embryonal carcinoma, and 2 had seminomas. The benign teratomas were removed by simple extirpation without complications. The malignant teratomas were highly invasive, and despite extensive operations and postoperative radiotherapy, 3 of the 4 patients died within 9 months. One patient with predominantly seminomatous differentation of the teratoma was alive and well more than 3 years after the operation. The patient with an embryonal carcinoma died after 4 months. One of the 2 patients with seminoma remained alive 20 years after radical excision and postoperative radiotherapy. The other, who had a huge seminoma, died during operation. The prognosis in patients with seminomas or with predominantly seminomatous structures in teratomas seems to be good after combined radical excision and radiotherapy, although nonradical resection followed by raditherapy may be justified in high-risk patients.
abstract_ja: 胸腺および胸腺領域の腫瘍82例のうち、奇形腫と胚細胞性腫瘍は11例であった。このうち4例は良性嚢胞性奇形腫、4例は悪性奇形腫、1例は胎児性癌、2例はセミノーマであった。良性奇形腫は単純切除により合併症なく摘出された。悪性奇形腫は高度に浸潤性で、広範な手術と術後の放射線療法を行ったにもかかわらず、4例中3例が9か月以内に死亡した。奇形腫の成分が主にセミノーマ性の分化を示した1例は、手術後3年以上にわたり健在であった。胎児性癌の1例は4か月後に死亡した。セミノーマ2例のうち1例は、根治的切除と術後放射線療法の後、20年間生存した。もう1例は巨大なセミノーマで、手術中に死亡した。セミノーマまたは奇形腫内にセミノーマ性の構造が主体となる症例の予後は、根治的切除と放射線療法の併用により良好と思われるが、ハイリスク患者では非根治的切除に続く放射線療法が正当化される可能性がある。
